description: Get the status of a background job in a project, e.g. the copy started by copy_project or a background import_owl. Returns { jobDetailsId, projectId, type, status, createdAt, lastUpdatedAt } where status is "inProgress", "success" or "failed". Result-bearing jobs (background import_owl) additionally return a 'result' field on success — for OWL imports it carries the type/element/taxonomy counts and the aggregated lossiness. Poll until status is no longer "inProgress"; leave a few seconds between polls.

graphProjectId.description: Id of the project the job belongs to. For copy_project this is the returned (destination) projectId.

jobDetailsId.description: The jobDetailsId returned by the tool that started the job.

name: get_job_status
title: Get Job Status
